view.description: me (what this login may do), explain (why an operation was refused), users, groups, activity (Forward's audit log: who called which route, when)

network_id.description: me: show what the role on this network allows; explain: the network the refusal was on; activity: shorthand for the route prefix /networks/<id>/, with match as the rest of the path

operation.description: explain: the refused operation, for example EDIT_CHECKS or NetworkOperation.EDIT_CHECKS

error.description: explain: Forward's 403 message, for example "Missing permission: NetworkOperation.EDIT_CHECKS"

user.description: users: one user by id, username or email; activity: only this user's requests

match.description: users or groups: a substring of the name; activity: a prefix of the route, for example /networks/123/classic-devices (case-insensitive, no /api)

limit.description: users, groups or activity: rows per page

offset.description: users, groups or activity: rows to skip

since.description: activity: start of the window, as a span back from now (7d, 48h, 90m) or an RFC 3339 time; default 7d

method.description: activity: only this HTTP method (a change is POST, PUT, PATCH or DELETE)

until.description: activity: end of the window, as a span back from now or an RFC 3339 time; default now

status.description: activity: only requests that succeeded (2xx, 3xx) or failed (4xx, 5xx)
